model.description: A File unit MUST carry its FILENAME in name (name=filename, location=real path, sourceFile=ior:file:<real path>, ownerIor SET) — never a raw UUID where the name belongs. TRON MAJOR REGRESSION (relayed via PO 2026-08-29, prod.wo-da.de:4444): prod File-unit JSON shows ownerIor=NULL; name=a raw UUID (b9fa43a2-ea98-…) instead of a filename; location=the SAME raw uuid; sourceFile=ior:file:b9fa43a2-… — File units carry UUIDs where the NAME belongs. It RENDERS CORRECTLY on an OLDER TEST server = a two-server bisect (the data/generation changed between test and prod, not the renderer). ROOT is the ARCHITECT's (code/data/generation — diffing the same File unit from prod vs test); THIS req captures the SYMPTOM + the correct shape + failable gates. SYMPTOM-ONLY, do NOT build a fix until the root is known.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ensureViewUnit REFUSES a path ref whose payload is a bare UUID — FAIL-CLOSED. Ruled root of the 5 name=uuid File units: a bad caller passes file:<uuid> (the source-file UUID) as a path ref, and ensureViewUnit mints a File whose name IS that uuid. FIX: ensureViewUnit('file:<v4-uuid>') returns null (refuse), never mints a uuid-named File. The 5 model-store-only symptom units (incl 5fbed155 name=b9fa43a2) are the RED baseline. 'File names are paths' is the unenforced-wish this enforces.
